title: Distribution-free inference on the number of changepoints
abstract: arXiv:2609.08234v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Suppose we are given an ordered sequence of independent data whose distribution changes $K$ times at unknown locations, for some unknown $K \geq 0$. In this paper, we study the problem of performing distribution-free inference on $K$. First, we show an impossibility result: any distribution-free upper confidence bound on $K$ must be trivial and uninformative. Then, using conformal $p$-values, and under only the assumption that the data segments induced by the changepoints are exchangeable (within themselves) and mutually independent, we construct a finite-sample valid lower confidence bound on $K$, which we call the Conformal LOwer bound on Changepoint Count (CLOCC). We show that CLOCC is the only feasible way to provide a lower bound on $K$ under the stated assumptions, a property we refer to as its universality. We provide practical guidelines for choosing score functions that yield efficient and tight lower bounds. We evaluate CLOCC

translated_title: 关于变点数量的分布无关推断
translated_abstract: 假设我们给定一个有序的独立数据序列，其分布在未知位置发生变化K次，其中K ≥ 0为未知数。在本文中，我们研究对K进行分布无关推断的问题。首先，我们展示了一个不可能性结果：任何关于K的分布无关上置信界必定是平凡的且无信息量的。然后，利用共形p值，在仅假设由变点产生的数据段（内部）可交换且相互独立的条件下，我们构建了一个有限样本有效的关于K的下置信界，我们称之为变点数量的共形下界。我们证明在所述假设下，CLOCC是提供K下界的唯一可行方法，我们将这一性质称为其普适性。我们为选择能够产生高效且紧密下界的评分函数提供了实用指南。我们评估了CLOCC
tldr: 本文证明了对变点数量K构造分布无关上置信界是不可能的，并提出了基于共形p值的有限样本有效下置信界CLOCC，在数据段仅满足内部可交换且相互独立的温和假设下具有普适性。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that any distribution-free upper confidence bound on the number of changepoints K must be trivial, and proposes CLOCC, a finite-sample valid conformal lower confidence bound on K that is universal under only segment-wise exchangeability and mutual independence assumptions.
